==Luhhan vs Lubhan==

I feel this incredible need to dance around while waving my arms and producing vague and indefensible gibberish-like explanations for why I thought Haral and Alsbet ''Luhhan'' were actually Haral and Alsbet ''Lubhan'', but I an going to suppress such indicators of deep embarrassment and simply say thank you for handling my mistake with diplomacy and panache.  

The bad news is that I am good at making bonehead (no offense meant to any Minbari reading this post) mistakes; the good news is that I am also good at admitting them and amending my behavior (I've had lots of practice).--[[User:Pedantic|Pedantic]] 18:55, 13 February 2008 (UTC)
